subject: [PATCH v4 3/3] mm: zswap: use stack requests for synchronous decompression

2026-10-17.patch_summary: This patch modifies the zswap decompression mechanism to use stack requests instead of heap requests for synchronous decompression. This change aims to reduce serialization on the per-CPU decompression mutex, which was causing stalls in high-priority loads due to low-priority loads holding onto the mutex after being preempted. The patch allows synchronous algorithms to use on-stack requests, which eliminates the need for a zswap lock and reduces the load path depth by about 270 bytes on x86-64. Asynchronous algorithms continue to use per-CPU requests and mutexes.
